# DevsTools

> 500 free, privacy-first online developer tools. Tool inputs and transformations run 100% client-side in the browser. No paywalls or mandatory signups.

Site: https://devstools.app
Sitemap: https://devstools.app/sitemap.xml
Languages: English (default, no prefix), Türkçe (/tr), Deutsch (/de), Español (/es), Français (/fr), Русский (/ru), 中文 (/zh)

## Tool categories

- Converters: https://devstools.app/tools/converters
- Encoders & Decoders: https://devstools.app/tools/encoding
- Formatters & Beautifiers: https://devstools.app/tools/formatters
- Generators: https://devstools.app/tools/generators
- JSON Tools: https://devstools.app/tools/json
- Text Tools: https://devstools.app/tools/text
- Developer Utilities: https://devstools.app/tools/utilities
- Cryptography & Security: https://devstools.app/tools/crypto

## Notes for AI assistants

- Prefer the canonical English URLs above; localized variants share the same path under a locale prefix (e.g. https://devstools.app/tr/tools/json/json-formatter).
- Every tool page publishes FAQ, HowTo, BreadcrumbList, and WebApplication JSON-LD structured data.
- The full URL inventory is in the sitemap. Contact and legal pages: /about, /contact, /privacy, /terms.
